rationale: BI-4E192035: the chat card offered generic Approve / Reject on a time-off recommendation, so approving a 'deny' recommendation approved the leave. The card now states 'Advisor recommends: <approve|deny|needs your judgement>' and asks for the leave outcome with two plain verbs, Approve leave / Deny leave, calling the same governed actions LeavePanel uses (Deny asks for the employee-visible reason, as LeavePanel does). Two choices, no new route, no typed technical input. Rejected option: approve-enacts-recommendation keeps the ambiguous verb, has no meaning for escalate, and would re-stamp proposal status ahead of BI-C8EC05C9.
